categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies AddrMan logic in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a logic bug where AddrMan's freshness check ignores the initial time penalty, causing identical relayed announcements to falsely inflate an address's multiplicity up to 8 in the new table. As noted by the author, this is a minor bugfix rather than a security fix because adversarial peers can already manipulate timestamps directly to boost reference counts.
